response.sql:
WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
)
SELECT
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares
ORDER BY difference_from_average_share DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Average share means the unweighted mean of the shares across observatories that have at least one telescope; observatories with no telescopes have no row in telescopes and are not counted.
